No drug allergies, no pregnancy, and lifestyle factors (social alcohol, no tobacco, low caffeine) are unremarkable. Phenelzine is a non-selective MAOI that irreversibly inhibits monoamine oxidase A and B, preventing serotonin degradation. When an MAOI is started after an SSRI, the residual serotonin from the SSRI can accumulate, leading to serotonin syndrome - a potentially life-threatening condition characterized by autonomic instability, neuromuscular excitation, and altered mental status.\n\nPATIENT-SPECIFIC ANALYSIS: Although the patient stopped fluoxetine 6 weeks ago, the SSRI's metabolites (e.g., norfluoxetine) may still be present in the synaptic space for several weeks.
